summary: Both editions require revision. The standard reader text faithfully covers the selected working Greek, but its theological metadata imports claims from outside this unit. The simplified text independently omits both commands to listen and also has inaccurate unit-specific metadata. The disclosed bracketed working readings need not be replaced merely because alternatives exist. The notes are compatible with the supplied bounded reports; this review does not authenticate unseen manuscripts, verify the cited editions independently, or certify exhaustive collation.
